thread:
maria.j: heads up — launch pushed 10.5k leads a few minutes ago. lots are stuck in enrichment and RR is skewing hard to two owners. SLA alerts firing.

teresa.k: yikes. which workflow? any sample errors?

maria.j: workflow: launch2026-handoff-v1. HubSpot shows enrichment retries; sample webhook: POST /enrich status=504 latency=14s lead=L-9001.

hubspot-bot: [ALERT] workflow=launch2026-handoff-v1 enrichment_timeouts=482 assign_retries=138 in last_30m

daniel.f: quick theory — enrichment service is throttling. allocator retries while owner state still pending, creating duplicate claims and skew.

maria.j: proposed short-term: enable "minimal-profile fastpath" for campaign=="launch-2026" after 8s. attach {email,name,campaign} and route to overflow-sdr-pool with fallback_owner sales-temp. bump claim_heartbeat 30->80s for the workflow.

teresa.k: agree. also decrease assign_batch_size 200->60 for that campaign to reduce contention. add alert pending_assignments>400.

daniel.f: plan of action:
- canary 5% for fastpath + heartbeat + batch change
- monitor pending_assignments, owner_skew_ratio, crm_visibility_time
- backfill DLQ for leads that hit fastpath when enrichment later completes

ops-bot: creating incident ticket INC-2026-901, assignees: daniel.f, teresa.k

maria.j: snippet from enrichment logs:
```
POST /enrich
status: 429
body: {"lead":"L-9001","retry_after":25}
```

teresa.k: long-term fixes: deterministic allocator hashing on external_id+campaign, tiny distributed lease (100ms) during enrichment callback, and a DLQ route to CRM after 4 assignment retries. also add campaign burst SLOs in runbook.

daniel.f: canary live now (tag: launch-fastpath-canary). will watch metrics for 10m then roll.

hubspot-bot: canary metrics after 2m: pending_assignments 412 -> 68, owner_skew_ratio 6.1 -> 1.4, assign_retries_rate 21% -> 4%.

maria.j: nice. notify @sales — expect slightly reduced enrichment for these leads for ~1h; CRM visibility will be prioritized.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-901 status=monitoring next_check=5m

teresa.k: follow-ups: add runbook entry for fastpath tradeoffs, create an automated rollback if crm_upsert_noop_rate > 1.5%, and schedule a postmortem to harden allocator.

maria.j: thanks team. if backlog creeps >500 ping paging. :thumbsup:
